text.p: A news conference called by European Internal Market Commissioner Mario Monti to present a green paper on pension funds was cancelled on Tuesday because no reporters showed up.

The conference was organised in Strasbourg, where the European Commission held its weeekly meeting, and Monti showed up to explain the much-delayed paper aimed at putting the creation of a single market for funds back on track.
Reporters gathered in the Commission's press room in Brussels, to which the conference was due to be broadcast, had to make do with the press statements.

The Italian Commissioner had to compete with the arrival in Strasbourg of several heads of government attending the European People's Party meeting ahead of next week's EU summit -- including Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi who drained off the Italian press.
